text: dsh-prompt-profile 是 DSH 的 Markdown 提示词配置插件，可通过 /prompt-profile 发现、列出并运行用户和项目目录中的配置。配置支持提示词正文、参数占位符及可选的 provider、model 和 reasoning effort；同名项目配置覆盖用户配置。运行时可临时选择模型，并在 agent 空闲后恢复之前的选择。适合复用任务提示词、传入命令参数或按任务切换模型的 DSH 用户。配置保存在本地，无需额外密钥或外部服务。

dsh-prompt-profile runs reusable Markdown prompts with /prompt-profile. Profiles support arguments and optional model selection; project files override user files. A run can restore the previous model when the agent becomes idle. Profiles are local and need no extra key or service.

dsh-prompt-profile 的功能「配置发现与覆盖」：递归读取用户和项目目录中的 Markdown 配置，按相对路径形成配置名；项目目录后加载，因此同名项目配置会覆盖用户配置。使用 /prompt-profile 加名称运行。
dsh-prompt-profile 的功能「参数填入提示词」：命令行参数经过引号解析后可替换正文中的 $1、$2、$@、$ARGUMENTS、@$ 和 ${@:N:L} 等占位符，再作为用户消息提交给 agent。
dsh-prompt-profile 的功能「单轮模型选择与恢复」：配置可指定 provider、model 和 reasoningEffort；运行时设置 agent 模型，并可在空闲后恢复旧选择。
dsh-prompt-profile 的功能「列出可用配置」：使用 /prompt-profile list 或不带名称调用命令，可按名称排序列出配置及其描述和来源；没有配置时返回空状态提示。

dsh-prompt-profile README · dsh-prompt-profile：Reusable Markdown prompt profiles for DeepSeek Harness. A profile can select a provider, model, and reasoning effort for one turn, render command arguments into its body, and restore the previous selection afterward.

dsh-prompt-profile README · Why this exists 💡：Model choice and review instructions are often repeated across sessions. `dsh-prompt-profile` turns those combinations into small, reusable Markdown profiles that can be invoked for one turn and then leave the Agent's previous model selection intact.

dsh-prompt-profile README · Features ✨：- Discover profiles from user and project directories, with project profiles taking precedence.
- Substitute positional arguments into profile bodies with shell-style placeholders.
- Select a provider, model, and reasoning effort for one turn.
- Restore the previous Agent selection automatically or opt out per profile.
- List available profiles and invoke nested profiles by slash-separated names.

dsh-prompt-profile README · Install 📦：```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add ./dsh-prompt-profile
```

Create a user profile under `~/.dsh/prompt-profiles/` or a project profile under `<repo>/.dsh/prompt-profiles/`:

```markdown
---
description: Deep code review
provider: deepseek
model: deepseek-reasoner

Project profiles override user profiles with the same relative name.

dsh-prompt-profile README · Use 🚀：```text
/prompt-profile list
/prompt-profile review src/index.ts "focus on cancellation"
```

Nested files use slash-separated names. For example, `.dsh/prompt-profiles/review/security.md` is `review/security`.

Supported placeholders:

| Placeholder | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `$1`, `$2`, … | One positional argument |
| `$@`, `@$`, `$ARGUMENTS` | All arguments |
| `${@:N}` | Arguments from position N |
| `${@:N:L}` | L arguments from position N |

dsh-prompt-profile README · Frontmatter 🧾：| Field | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `description` | No | Text shown by `/prompt-profile list` |
| `provider` | With `model` | Harness provider route |
| `model` | With `provider` | Provider-owned model ID |
| `reasoningEffort` | With `provider` and `model` | Adapter-owned reasoning effort ID |
| `restore` | No | Restore the prior selection after the turn; defaults to `true` |

Omit both `provider` and `model` to use the current agent selection.

dsh-prompt-profile README · Configure ⚙️：```yaml
- id: dsh-prompt-profile
  name: dsh-prompt-profile
  config:
    userDirectory: ~/.dsh/prompt-profiles

dsh-prompt-profile README · Develop 🧑‍💻：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check
```

Commit the generated `lib/` files with source changes so Git installs include the declared package entry before build scripts run.

dsh-prompt-profile README · Scope 🎯：Version 0.1 intentionally omits prompt chains, loops, skill injection, subagents, worktrees, and best-of-N orchestration. Those features should be added only when Harness extension points can preserve their lifecycle and durable-session semantics.

dsh-prompt-profile README · Credits 🙏：The core idea comes from [`pi-prompt-template-model`](https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-prompt-template-model). This first Harness-native release focuses on the smallest useful unit: deterministic discovery, argument substitution, scoped model routing, and restoration.
